title: Dubai DLD Project Construction Database
license: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the republisher for this dataset
attribution: Continental Club Property, based on Dubai Land Department project registry data. Dataset "Dubai DLD Project Construction Database", snapshot of 14 November 2026. https://continentalclub.ae/data/project-status.csv
v48IdentityCrosswalk: 83 reviewed one-to-one V48 identities were rechecked by project number, project name, developer and source district against this 14 November snapshot; 3,799 source IDs remain unmatched. No new identity is inferred from the 11 added source rows. Previous evidence URLs and district-alias review remain in the crosswalk.
limits: This is a dated CC BY 4.0 republished DLD register snapshot, not a live DLD API or an all-UAE census. Percentages are last recorded technical inspections and may be stale; handover dates are declared, not actual. The page prose claims 3,883 rows and 16 fields, while its downloadable CSV has 3,882 rows and 14 fields; the page metadata says 3,882 projects. The land-number field is a truncated source display for many records and its displayed order can change between captures; do not use it as a project identity. The 83 reviewed V48 identity links do not supply geometry, sales, prices, or new project-pin coordinates, and do not revise V48 status or timelines.
